summary: This directory contains unit tests for the analysis components responsible for evaluating symbol dependencies and detecting effect signals within the source code, ensuring the accuracy of the static analysis logic.
responsibilities: Verify the accuracy of dependency analysis between symbols
Validate the detection logic for effect-based signals
Ensure regression testing for analysis modules
relationships: The unit tests validate the core analysis logic by exercising individual components responsible for tracking symbol dependencies.
Detection of effect signals relies on the underlying analysis framework to identify specific patterns within the code.
designDecisions: Colocation of test suites with their corresponding analysis implementation logic
Isolation of testing logic from the primary source code execution path
